label: Count panel reports by assigning a Boolean to each observed live ray
description: Assign one bit to each ray in the image of the live observations, reading it at each live position and reporting off elsewhere. Each live ray has a representative observation, so different assignments give different reports. Every feasible report supplies a well-defined bit on each observed live ray by within-ray agreement. Apply the finite function-space cardinality formula. This measures possible reports, with no frequency or probability law assumed.
